nodes.text: Markets seem to be on a downward drift. Each week brings a fresh reason: HMPV virus, USD/INR rates, FII selling, US10Y, Brent and now LA wildfires. Add to that budget worries and Trump's return on the horizon.Index may break more but few stocks had already made low.
